text:
alicia: Hey team — spotted a weird skew in the per-invocation cost card on the console. Some low-latency requests show token cost way higher than expected. Anyone else?

mike: saw that on staging this morning. pattern: short prompts but high kv-cache miss charges.

sandeep: are we sure it’s not double-counting prefetch credits? last week we changed how shared prefetch is attributed.

judy: screenshots? can you paste an example invocation id?

alicia: invc_20231123_9ab3f. quick log: 
```
metric: tokens_billed=12, cache_prefetch_credit=0, kv_cache_hits=0, model=redwood-7b-q8
billing_units: computed_cost_usd=0.0123
```

mike: weird — should've had kv cache hit for prefix on that route. router trace shows it routed to variant v2 which has a slightly different key prefixing.

zach: routing change last week added variant suffix to cache keys for safety. maybe some routes still write old keys.

judy: ops-bot, can you pull backend sampling for that invocation id?

ops-bot: pulled sample: 
{
  "invc":"invc_20231123_9ab3f",
  "route":"/chat/stream",
  "model":"redwood-7b-q8",
  "cache_key":"user:123:prompt:hash:old",
  "routing_variant":"v2-suffix"
}

sandeep: aha — cache_key mismatch. v2-suffix reads different key, so miss, then we count full token cost plus a prefetch attempt that failed. We never exposed "cache_key_version" in the console, so operators can't debug this.

alicia: proposed quick fix: add a debug toggle in the cost card "show cache attribution" that surfaces cache_key version, prefetch attempts, and crediting decisions for sampled invocations. default off to avoid noise.

mike: +1. but we need to think telemetry volume. per-invocation debug fields are heavy. sampling rate? 1% by default? maybe configurable per-tenant for enterprise.

judy: also legal/product concern: don't leak full prompt text in debug UI. must only show hashes and meta.

sandeep: agreed. For API, suggest adding new internal endpoint /internal/cost-debug?sample=true which returns minimal fields: invocation_id, model, tokens_billed, cache_key_version, prefetch_attempts, credited_cache_bytes. header X-Debug-Auth for access.

zach: internal API debate: should router emit cost-debug envelope as part of request lifecycle (push) or should console poll per-invocation? Push is real-time but increases load on telemetry pipeline. Poll is simpler but slower.

mike: I'd lean push for canary phase but only for sampled invocations; push messages go to a "cost-debug" Kafka topic with rate limit and TTL. Then console subscribes when debug toggle is on for the tenant.

alicia: UX: in the cost card show a tiny badge "debug" when we have a sampled trace, clicking expands a flyout with the fields and a link "open full debug in infra" which is restricted.

judy: rollout plan: 1) API + minimal console UI behind feature flag; 2) enable 0.1% sampling org-wide; 3) enable tenant-level override for enterprise; 4) monitor telemetry ingestion and cost.

sandeep: implementation note: we must avoid re-calculating cost in the router. Use the billing service as single source of truth. Router should emit cache events (hit/miss/prefetch) with refs; billing joins later.

zach: add a small SQL probe we can run to reconcile misses vs billed cost: 
```
SELECT invocation_id, billed_tokens, sum(case when event='cache_hit' then 1 else 0 end) as hits, sum(case when event='prefetch' then 1 else 0 end) as prefetches
FROM billing.invocations v
LEFT JOIN telemetry.cache_events e ON v.invocation_id = e.invocation_id
WHERE v.invocation_ts > now() - interval '3 days'
GROUP BY invocation_id, billed_tokens
ORDER BY billed_tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

mike: nice. I'll add the query to the ops runbook.

alicia: any objections to me drafting the feature-flag RFC today? include privacy, sampling, topic schemas, and a short mitigation plan for high-volume tenants.

judy: go for it. cc @legal on the RFC draft for the privacy wording.

sandeep: I'll prototype the cost-debug Kafka envelope this afternoon and push a stub to eng-platform repo.

zach: I'll follow up on router key migration to ensure backward compatibility.

alicia: thanks all — feels good to have a concrete plan. we'll reconvene Fri to review RFC + prototype. :thumbsup:
